glosses: to cast away, to throw out

forms.form:
te zullen wegwerpen
weg te zullen werpen

glosses: zich van iets ontdoen (omdat het geen waarde meer heeft) meestal na een zeer beperkt aantal keren gebruikt te hebben

examples.text: We leven nu in een wegwerpmaatschappij!

glosses: To discard (trash, garbage, or the like), to toss out, to put in the trash.

examples.text: He wanted to throw away the cup, but he couldn't find a trash can.
Don't throw the newspaper away, it goes in the recycle bin!
Voting for a third-party candidate sometimes feels like throwing your vote away.
The team threw away its chance at the semifinals.
Mama, life has just begun. / But now I've gone and thrown it all away.
Chelsea threw away two points when substitute Salomon Kalou gifted Valencia a penalty five minutes from time with a needless handball.

glosses: To intentionally throw an incomplete pass.
To give lightly, in an offhand manner.

examples.text: As Gilly plays sitcom wife, reading aloud from a book while Sam tries to read his own across the table, she throws away a line about someone named Maynard once having annulled the marriage of someone named Prince Raggar and remarrying him in the same ceremony in Dorne.

glosses: Arrojar, empujar algo para dotarle de una velocidad inicial y que recorra una distancia.

examples.text: Se lanzó el paquete de ayuda sobre la población.
Se lanzará una nueva campaña publicitaria.

glosses: Privarle a alguien la posesión de un bien.
